summary: Animate any still image on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right i2v model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks HappyHorse 1.0 I2V (Arena #1, native audio, identity preservation) for general animations, Wan 2.7 with `audio_url` for custom-voiceover…
whenToUse: Use when animating a still image into a video on RunComfy, including portrait animation, product reveals or lip-sync to a custom voiceover.
